title: The Fable: The Second Contact
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel set about a year after The Fable: elite hitman Akira Sato and his partner Yoko, living under assumed identities, abort a mission because of the Covid-19 pandemic and return to Osaka to resume ordinary civilian life, but the peace does not last. The franchise premise is a feared killer ordered to live as a normal citizen without killing, among Osaka yakuza.
life_message: A trained killer trying to live an ordinary, quiet life among ordinary people is held up as worth protecting (franchise premise; to verify for this sequel).
